entries.description: Point lookup at a charging bucket
entries.ti_sql: SELECT "robot.motor_current@mean" AS current, "robot.mode" AS mode FROM telemetry WHERE entity='robots.urn:robot:1' AND ts=TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01 00:17:00'
entries.oracle_sql: SELECT "robot.motor_current@mean" AS current, "robot.mode" AS mode FROM telemetry WHERE entity='robots.urn:robot:1' AND ts=TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01 00:17:00'

entries.ti_sql: SELECT entity, count(*) AS n FROM telemetry WHERE entity LIKE 'robots.urn:%' GROUP BY entity ORDER BY entity
entries.oracle_sql: SELECT entity, count(*) AS n FROM telemetry WHERE entity LIKE 'robots.urn:%' GROUP BY entity ORDER BY entity

entries.ti_sql: SELECT vessel, count(*) AS n FROM telemetry WHERE "robot.battery_voltage@min" < 24.6 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel
entries.oracle_sql: SELECT vessel, count(*) AS n FROM telemetry WHERE "robot.battery_voltage@min" < 24.6 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

entries.ti_sql: SELECT entity, CAST(date_bin(INTERVAL '1 day',ts) AS DATE) AS day, min("robot.motor_current@min") AS current FROM telemetry WHERE entity LIKE 'robots.urn:%' GROUP BY entity,day ORDER BY entity,day
entries.oracle_sql: SELECT entity, CAST(time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day',ts) AS DATE) AS day, min("robot.motor_current@min") AS current FROM telemetry WHERE entity LIKE 'robots.urn:%' GROUP BY entity,day ORDER BY entity,day

entries.ti_sql: SELECT vessel,count(*) AS n FROM telemetry WHERE "robot.mode"='charging' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel
entries.oracle_sql: SELECT vessel,count(*) AS n FROM telemetry WHERE "robot.mode"='charging' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

entries.ti_sql: SELECT vessel,count(*) AS n FROM telemetry WHERE "robot.fault"='battery' AND NOT ("robot.mode"='charging') AND "robot.battery_voltage@min"<24.6 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel
entries.oracle_sql: SELECT vessel,count(*) AS n FROM telemetry WHERE "robot.fault"='battery' AND NOT ("robot.mode"='charging') AND "robot.battery_voltage@min"<24.6 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

entries.ti_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM telemetry WHERE "robot.motor_current$source"='default'
entries.oracle_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM telemetry WHERE list_contains("robot.motor_current$source",'default')

entries.description: Battery interval count and matching bucket count
entries.ti_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n,sum(buckets) AS buckets FROM intervals('"robot.battery_voltage@min" < 24.6', min_len => '600s')
entries.oracle_sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT vessel,bucket,bucket-row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY vessel ORDER BY bucket) AS island FROM telemetry WHERE "robot.battery_voltage@min"<24.6), ranges AS (SELECT vessel,island,count(*) AS n FROM matched GROUP BY vessel,island HAVING (max(bucket)-min(bucket)+1)*10>=600) SELECT count(*) AS n,sum(n) AS buckets FROM ranges

entries.ti_sql: SELECT entity,max("robot.pose_x@max") AS x FROM telemetry WHERE entity LIKE 'robots.urn:%' GROUP BY entity ORDER BY entity
entries.oracle_sql: SELECT entity,max("robot.pose_x@max") AS x FROM telemetry WHERE entity LIKE 'robots.urn:%' GROUP BY entity ORDER BY entity

entries.description: OR/NOT states preserve ordinary single values
entries.ti_sql: SELECT vessel,count(*) AS n FROM telemetry WHERE NOT ("robot.mode"='charging' OR "robot.fault"='battery') GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel
entries.oracle_sql: SELECT vessel,count(*) AS n FROM telemetry WHERE NOT ("robot.mode"='charging' OR "robot.fault"='battery') GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

entries.ti_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM docs WHERE match(body,'battery')
entries.oracle_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM docs WHERE body ILIKE '%battery%'

entries.ti_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM telemetry WHERE match(notes,'battery')
entries.oracle_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM telemetry t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM docs d WHERE d.vessel=t.vessel AND d.kind='notes' AND d.body ILIKE '%battery%' AND t.ts>=d.ts_start AND t.ts<d.ts_end)

entries.description: Documents join telemetry in half-open ranges
entries.ti_sql: SELECT d.id,count(*) AS n FROM docs d JOIN telemetry t ON d.entity=t.entity AND t.ts>=d.ts_start AND t.ts<d.ts_end GROUP BY d.id ORDER BY d.id
entries.oracle_sql: SELECT d.id,count(*) AS n FROM docs d JOIN telemetry t ON d.entity=t.entity AND t.ts>=d.ts_start AND t.ts<d.ts_end GROUP BY d.id ORDER BY d.id
